stories.summary: New Delhi: The 1984 anti-Sikh riots remain a "tragic and shameful" chapter in the country's history, says Congress leader Sonia Gandhi, asserting that while her husband Rajiv Gandhi's heart held no bigotry or rancour, he was thrust into a moment of history when effective governance

stories.summary: Misinformation to trigger fear among people emerging as serious issue, smart policing can prevent it: President Murmu New Delhi, President Droupadi Murmu on Tuesday said that spreading misinformation to trigger fear among people is emerging as a serious issue and smart policing can prevent situations

stories.title: India rejects US commission remarks on Gurdwara attacks
stories.summary: The Indian government has rejected recent remarks from a US commission regarding attacks on Gurdwaras, describing the comments as blatantly political. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh approves new policy frameworks for emerging tech
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet approved the AVGC-XR Policy 2026-31 and the Robotics and Physical AI Policy 2026-36. The government aims to attract investments in artificial intelligence, electronics, and renewable energy. The state also cleared amendments to its existing Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy 2024-29.

stories.title: Telangana to host international Bharat Summit
stories.summary: The Telangana government will host the Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad on November 13 and 14. The event will gather political leaders and academics from 70 countries to discuss global challenges. Deliberations will focus on democracy, climate change, and the changing global order.

stories.title: Congress announces second Bharat Summit in Hyderabad
stories.summary: The Congress-led Telangana government will host the second Bharat Summit from November 12 to 14. The gathering expects over 1,000 delegates from 70 countries to discuss global political developments and democratic values. The summit aims to foster cooperation between the Global South and Global North.

stories.title: Patna civic body lists bonds on stock exchange
stories.summary: The Patna civic body has raised Rs 200 crore through bonds and secured a listing on the stock exchange. Further details regarding the issuance are unavailable as the source website has restricted access to the report.

stories.title: Government invites fresh applications for medical device PLI scheme
stories.summary: The government has invited new applications for the Rs 2,700 crore production linked incentive scheme for medical devices, extending the program until 2035-36. Revised guidelines remove minimum sales thresholds and reduce capital expenditure requirements. The changes are intended to promote ease of doing business.

stories.title: Home Minister launches startup initiative in Vadakara
stories.summary: Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala launched the Startup E Plus initiative at a government school in Vadakara on Tuesday. The project aims to nurture entrepreneurial skills among students and includes a specially equipped vehicle to visit educational institutions. The minister noted that a global technological revolution is creating new opportunities.

stories.title: Energy infrastructure startups secure larger funding rounds
stories.summary: Startups building hardware for India's energy infrastructure are raising follow-on rounds significantly larger than previous fundraises. Investors are increasing bets on grid management and storage technologies. Bengaluru-based Enerzolve is currently in talks to raise $20 million from existing investors to expand its smart meter and power conversion operations.

stories.title: Quick commerce drives festive sales for D2C brands
stories.summary: Direct-to-consumer brands reported doubled year-on-year sales during the festive season, with founders crediting quick-commerce platforms for the growth. Despite cautious consumer spending, categories including beauty, healthy snacks, and gifting saw strong performance. Quick commerce has reportedly delivered a significant triumph for the sector.

stories.title: Blackstone to acquire 16 percent stake in IIFL Finance
stories.summary: Blackstone will invest Rs 5,000 crore for a 16 percent stake in IIFL Finance. Co-promoters Nirmal Jain and R. Venkataraman will contribute Rs 1,264 crore through warrants, while Anchorage Capital will invest Rs 150 crore. The capital raise totals Rs 6,414 crore to support the company's growth.

stories.title: Solar consumers report policy hurdles in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: While 425.61 MW of domestic rooftop solar has been installed under the PM Surya Ghar scheme, consumers report that policy issues remain. Industry representatives note that despite government claims of zero energy charges, households must still pay network charges. The state is currently working to expand the program.

stories.title: Residents report petroleum contamination in Mahe wells
stories.summary: Residents of Palloor are protesting against petrol pumps in residential areas, alleging that fuel leaks have contaminated drinking water and rendered wells unusable. A joint action council has demanded the closure of outlets that violate safety norms. The Mahe administration has yet to resolve the ongoing agitation.

stories.title: Cyclone-hit villages in Andhra Pradesh face power outages
stories.summary: Villages in the Prakasam district remain without electricity following Cyclone Murasu. Residents are using oil lamps and paying for mobile charging in urban centers while restoration efforts continue. Access to drinking water and fuel remains a challenge for those living in the affected coastal areas.

stories.title: Farm fire estimates exceed official counts in Punjab and Haryana
stories.summary: New estimates suggest farm fires in Punjab and Haryana have reached nearly 34,000 by November 9, far exceeding official tallies. Satellite data indicates that smoke-bearing winds are expected to return to Delhi on Wednesday and Thursday. The scale of the problem remains significantly higher than current counts.

stories.title: Parliamentary panel drops air pollution from meeting agenda
stories.summary: A Parliamentary committee has removed the issue of air pollution in the National Capital Region from the agenda of its November 17 meeting. The decision prompted objections from a Congress member. The panel had previously planned to hear from the Ministry of Home Affairs regarding the crisis.

stories.title: Supreme Court requests groundwater report for Rajasthan towns
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered a report on groundwater levels in Jodhpur, Balotra, and Pali. The court is examining pollution in Rajasthan river systems and expressed concern over the threat to regional water security caused by continued extraction by industrial units.

stories.title: Supreme Court demands vehicle pollution control plans
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed Delhi and three neighbouring states to explain how they regulate vehicle emissions and movement. The order follows a rise in pollution linked to vehicular traffic. The court is seeking urgent intervention to keep overage and polluting vehicles off the roads.

stories.title: FICCI estimates air pollution costs India $95 billion annually
stories.summary: The Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry has warned that air pollution results in an annual economic cost of $95 billion. Further details regarding the report are unavailable as the source website has restricted access to the information.

stories.title: CPCB defends 500-point AQI cap
stories.summary: The Central Pollution Control Board stated that the 500-point ceiling on the National Air Quality Index is an intentional feature consistent with international practices. The board clarified that readings exceeding this level would not change health advisories, despite private apps reporting significantly higher figures in Delhi.

stories.title: Dubai-bound tanker hit by projectile in Persian Gulf
stories.summary: A Liberian-flagged tanker, MT Fujairah Energy, was hit by a projectile while transiting the Persian Gulf on Tuesday. The vessel was carrying six Indian seafarers, one of whom was among four crew members injured in the attack. The remaining 18 crew members are reported safe.

stories.title: US officials hold trade talks in New Delhi
stories.summary: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month to discuss a proposed bilateral trade agreement. The meetings in New Delhi focused on customs and trade facilitation as both nations work toward an early conclusion of the deal's first tranche. The discussions are ongoing.

stories.title: India discusses food corridors with Russia and Ukraine
stories.summary: India has exchanged ideas with Russia and Ukraine regarding food corridors to facilitate grain exports from Black Sea ports. The proposal is part of a broader ceasefire initiative. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed the humanitarian aspects of the conflict during a recent call.

stories.title: India and US push for early bilateral trade deal
stories.summary: Indian and US officials met in New Delhi last week to discuss customs and trade facilitation. Both sides remain engaged in negotiations for the first tranche of a proposed bilateral trade agreement. Indian officials described the potential deal as mutually beneficial and ruled out any interruption in talks.

stories.title: India explores food corridor initiative for Black Sea
stories.summary: India is working with stakeholders to facilitate grain exports from Black Sea ports as part of a ceasefire proposal. During a call with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky suggested India could lead efforts to ensure uninterrupted food supplies through the region.

stories.title: COP31 opens amid record global temperatures
stories.summary: Global average temperatures between January and September reached 1.47°C above pre-industrial levels, according to the World Meteorological Organization. The 2026 update, released at the COP31 conference in Antalya, notes that the years 2023 to 2026 are the four hottest on record. The world is entering severe climate extremes.

stories.title: World Bank official praises India's water management
stories.summary: Global Director for Water at the World Bank, Saroj Kumar Jha, described India's water management initiatives as a remarkable success story. The country's efforts to restore rivers, improve drinking water access and strengthen dam safety are now being viewed by other developing nations as a model for solutions.

stories.title: Moody predicts weaker global credit conditions for 2027
stories.summary: Moody expects costlier credit, AI-led transformation and security premiums to drive credit risks next year. The agency noted that government intervention through tariffs and regulation will increasingly influence capital allocation. Highly leveraged borrowers face greater pressure, though banks and life insurers remain an exception to the trend.

stories.title: Luxembourg leads world in trade dependency
stories.summary: Luxembourg was the world’s most trade-dependent country in 2025, with exports and imports totaling 350% of its GDP, according to World Bank data. The figures highlight how smaller economies maintain cross-border flows several times larger than their annual economic output. San Marino and Singapore followed closely behind.

stories.title: TRAI caps charges for IP-based network links
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has capped fees for internet-based connections between networks. The move aims to retire decades-old technology still used to connect calls. This is the first time the regulator has implemented such a cap as part of a wider push for network modernization.

stories.title: Prosus plans expanded India fintech investments
stories.summary: Amsterdam-listed investor Prosus plans to increase its fintech investments in India, following recent stakes in Navi, Mintifi and Vastu Housing Finance. The firm is reportedly close to investing in the AI-led credit startup Oolka. Prosus continues to evaluate opportunities under strict new risk filters.

stories.title: Nvidia cloud partner under US investigation
stories.summary: Nvidia lists Megaspeed International as an official cloud partner. The Singapore-based company, led by shareholder Alice Huang, came under public attention in October 2025 following reports of a US investigation into whether it was assisting Chinese entities. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: SEC moves to close Tesla settlement fund
stories.summary: The SEC has asked a federal judge to close the Fair Fund created after Elon Musk’s 2018 settlement regarding his funding secured tweet. Musk and Tesla each paid $20 million in civil fines to compensate investor victims. The fund was established following the subsequent drop in share price.

stories.title: EU cyber chief warns of appliance security risks
stories.summary: Following cyberattacks on supermarket fridges across 12 European countries, the EU’s cybersecurity agency warned that home appliances could be next. Executive director Juhan Lepassaar urged Europe to increase security investment, stating that digital protection should not be an afterthought as connectivity expands to everyday household devices.

stories.title: Nvidia board investigates CEO affair
stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, a business executive identified by US intelligence as a purported Chinese government agent. The board launched an investigation into the relationship and potential national security concerns. The Chinese Foreign Ministry has denied the allegations.

stories.title: Trump expresses confidence in Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: Donald Trump stated he believes Jensen Huang amid allegations linking the Nvidia CEO to a suspected Chinese intelligence agent. While Republican lawmakers seek answers regarding potential export violations, Democrats are calling for increased oversight of semiconductor shipments to China. The investigation into the matter remains ongoing.

stories.title: Nvidia faces uncertainty following CEO scandal
stories.summary: Jensen Huang’s admission of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to inject uncertainty into the artificial intelligence ecosystem. While the stakes are high, the situation highlights the lack of privacy for executives at this level. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Nvidia controversy increases export scrutiny for Korean chipmakers
stories.summary: South Korean manufacturers Samsung and SK hynix may face increased export compliance burdens following reports linking Nvidia’s distribution channels to Chinese intelligence. The scrutiny follows the disclosure of CEO Jensen Huang’s personal relationship with a businesswoman suspected of ties to Beijing. Regulatory attention toward espionage measures has intensified.

stories.title: India calls for climate finance at COP31
stories.summary: India has urged developed nations to fulfill finance obligations under the Paris Agreement during the COP31 summit in Antalya. The government stated that public funding must remain central to climate action and adaptation in developing nations. The conference continues as countries debate the future of global climate commitments.

stories.title: US midterms and the climate landscape
stories.summary: Navtej Sarna writes that the US midterm elections have created new space for global climate cooperation. Amidst ongoing geopolitical conflicts and trade tensions, the author notes that performative grandstanding remains a risk at the COP31 summit in Antalya. The challenge of climate change persists despite the political noise.

stories.title: COP31 presidency pushes electrification pledge
stories.summary: The COP31 presidency in Antalya has proposed a 35-by-35 electrification pledge, aiming to increase electricity's share of global energy consumption to 35 percent by 2035. The initiative is voluntary, and many countries, including India, are reportedly considering whether to sign the commitment to transition away from fossil fuels.

stories.title: Electrolyser projects delayed to 2027
stories.summary: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has extended the commissioning deadline for electrolyser projects to August 2027. The move follows a slump in green hydrogen demand. Companies can now delay facility construction until they secure orders, providing flexibility for those participating in the production-linked incentive scheme.

stories.title: Water shortages threaten Indian power and crops
stories.summary: Reservoir levels across India have dropped 27 percent from last year, leaving many under two-thirds capacity following a dry monsoon. The depletion threatens irrigation, hydropower generation, and rabi crop sowing. Six states have already declared drought as the rural economy faces the impact of the water shortage.

stories.title: Netherlands questions tracking of Russian oil
stories.summary: The Netherlands stated it is difficult to track the origin of petroleum products, complicating the enforcement of EU sanctions on Russian crude. As a major gateway for imports, the country remains a top buyer of Indian petroleum products. India continues to be the second-largest buyer of Russian oil.

stories.title: Survey finds 38.6 million undiagnosed diabetes cases in India
stories.summary: An estimated 38.6 million adults in India are living with undiagnosed diabetes, according to a survey commissioned by the International Diabetes Federation. This group accounts for 43 percent of the total diabetic population. Many individuals remain unaware of their risk or how to access proper testing services.

stories.title: Telangana Women’s Commission probes fertility centres
stories.summary: The Telangana Women’s Commission is questioning five Hyderabad fertility centres following allegations of an illegal egg donation racket. Authorities rescued 43 women who were allegedly paid for egg collection. The investigation follows the arrest of nine individuals connected to the scheme in the state.

stories.title: Study links low weight and high blood pressure to heart risk
stories.summary: A study published in Hypertension Research suggests that being underweight while having high blood pressure is a high-risk category for cardiovascular events. The findings, focused on Asian populations, indicate increased risks for heart attacks and strokes, particularly among women and adults aged 40 and above.

stories.title: Shigella outbreak reported in Malappuram
stories.summary: Health officials in Malappuram have confirmed nine cases of Shigella infection following a wedding event. The department has initiated cleaning operations and well chlorination in the area. A special squad is conducting house-to-house surveillance to contain the spread of the infection after over 100 people reported symptoms.

stories.title: Cardiologists challenge ban on device reuse
stories.summary: The Cardiological Society of India is seeking a review of a DGHS order banning the sterilization and reuse of single-use medical devices. Cardiologists argue that the high cost of new equipment would make essential procedures like angioplasty inaccessible. Patient safety remains the stated reason for the original ban.

stories.title: FDA warns of vision loss risk from weight loss drugs
stories.summary: The FDA has alerted providers to a potential risk of non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy in patients using GLP-1 receptor agonists. The rare condition can lead to permanent vision loss. The regulator is informing patients of the symptoms to watch for while using these weight loss medications.

stories.title: Oxford returns Naga ancestral remains
stories.summary: Oxford University has officially transferred the custodianship of 39 Naga ancestral remains to the Naga people. The remains, previously held at the Pitt Rivers Museum for over a century, were handed over to the Forum for Naga Reconciliation. The items have now begun their journey home.

stories.title: Oxford completes repatriation of Naga remains
stories.summary: The University of Oxford has returned the remains of 39 Naga community members held at the Pitt Rivers Museum for more than 100 years. The formal handover to the Forum for Naga Reconciliation and the Naga Tribe Hoho took place on Monday. The repatriation marks a historic initiative.

stories.title: Virology conference to be held in Thiruvananthapuram
stories.summary: The Indian Virological Society is organizing the VIROCON 2026 conference in Thiruvananthapuram from November 11 to 13. The event will focus on emerging viral threats and the One Health approach. Scientists and industry professionals will discuss ecology, evolution, and future preparedness regarding human, animal, and plant viruses.

stories.title: Van Dyke claims regarding India arrest persist
stories.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs declined to comment on claims made by US citizen Mathew Aaron Van Dyke regarding his recent arrest in India. Van Dyke, who was released on bail after six months in Tihar jail, has threatened to reveal details about his incarceration and blamed Russia.

stories.title: Kochi marina to receive government attention
stories.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan promised action to improve the Kochi International Marina after a viral vlog highlighted its poor condition. The facility, commissioned in 2010, currently lacks yachts. The government plans to coordinate departmental efforts to restore the marina, which was built with Union Tourism Ministry funds.

stories.title: Gurugram police to implement automated transfers
stories.summary: Gurugram Police Commissioner Sibash Kabiraj has ordered traffic personnel to be transferred every 60 days using an automated system. The decision follows the arrest of a home guard for demanding bribes. Zonal officers will now be held accountable for the conduct of their staff.

stories.title: Gurugram police impound motorcycle with 67 pending challans
stories.summary: Gurugram traffic police impounded a motorcycle after discovering 67 unpaid challans totaling 4.06 lakh rupees. The vehicle was stopped during a routine check at the Damdama red light. The owner has managed to avoid the consequences of 67 separate traffic violations until now.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks digital arrest prevention plans from WhatsApp
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered WhatsApp and other intermediaries to submit proposals for preventing digital arrest scams and related cybercrimes. The bench, led by Chief Justice Surya Kant, also directed these companies to share their plans with the I4C. The court is currently reviewing the matter.

stories.title: JNU students report cleanliness issues during staff strike
stories.summary: JNU students report that campus cleanliness has declined as contractual workers continue their strike for an eighth day over bonus and leave disputes. The university administration denied any disruption to operations and stated that discussions with the workers are currently underway to resolve the matter.

stories.title: Children's Day falls on a Saturday this year
stories.summary: Children's Day falls on a Saturday this year, meaning students will miss out on a school holiday. Teachers are reportedly planning to perform on stage to compensate for the loss. It remains unclear how much the students will focus on the history of the holiday.

stories.title: Access denied to digital arrest report
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Access to the requested report on the Supreme Court's directive to WhatsApp regarding digital arrest prevention is currently unavailable on the server. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Keralam church adds open gym to campus
stories.summary: St. Joseph’s Church in Thrissur has installed an open gym on its premises to encourage fitness among parishioners. The facility is used by altar boys, parents, and senior citizens after Mass. Faith and fitness are now being practiced in the same location.
